title: complete_change input
description: Closes a change with its result, as the signed-in person: the change moves to completed (Balanced labels it Closed) and leaves the open part of the schedule. Served only to a person in the product's web app, because closing a change is a person's act and an AI client never completes a record (OP-08, G-08). Only an authorized change closes: one in progress (Balanced: Scheduled), or a submitted change whose type allows authorization after, such as an emergency. A failed, rolled back or partly succeeded result, or any result of a change type that requires a review after, opens the post-change review once.

resultKey.description: From the change result value list, such as succeeded or rolled back. Leave out to keep the result already recorded with record_change_result.

evidence.description: Links to proof, such as a test result. Each becomes an Evidence Link (O20).
